adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Later, for collective team events, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, the optional-chained `push` is a no-op, so `teamDestinationCalendars` (collected from other hosts in `users.slice(1)` when they have `user.destinationCalendar`) is never applied. This drops other collective hosts' destination calendars in that case, matching the finding.
